content: RESOLUTION of schizophrenia-causality open thread (3-system deep synthesis 2026-05-18). The resting place MOVED, toward more honesty not less. Original v1 framing: Bradford-Hill-satisfied probable component cause. Deep doc adds bidirectional MR + pleiotropy: forward MR supports causation (OR ~1.41, robust to tobacco adjustment); reverse MR shows schizophrenia genetic liability causally increases cannabis use disorder (OR 1.10 per doubling odds, p=2.64e-5); LCV/MR-PRESSO show widespread horizontal pleiotropy, genetic correlation rg=0.309 between CUD and schizophrenia. Sharpened conclusion: contributory-component-cause model SURVIVES (forward causal signal persists after pleiotropy correction; dose/potency/adolescent-window effects survive rigorous controls; Di Forti 2019 high-potency daily aOR ~4.8 intact) BUT a substantial fraction of the raw observational association is shared genetic etiology, not cannabis acting on a blank slate. This is a sharpening of WHAT KIND of cause, not a retreat from the harm claim. Self-discipline note: resisted the flip-to-panicked-correction failure mode the boot warned about -- widened the diagnostic instead of inverting the frame.
